title: R0_QUESTIONNAIRE — Alcohol, Smoking, and Diet (pseudonymised)

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern: the participant has not confirmed being a regular drinker (11:1), so start age, current-use status, and stop age are all structurally not applicable -- R0_AlcoholStartAge/R0_AlcoholCurrentUse/R0_AlcoholStopAge must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.
Skip pattern: the participant has not confirmed stopping drinking (11:1), so a stop age is structurally not applicable -- R0_AlcoholStopAge must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.

Alcohol routing: no AlcoholConsumption item carries a real 'other type' amount, so a description of the other type is structurally not applicable -- R0_AlcoholTypeOther must carry the missing-string sentinel. Array-contains trigger -- not one of SKIP-PATTERNS.md's documented forms; schemify has no nested-array guidance (flagged for upstream proposal, see DECISIONS.md).

Skip pattern: the participant has not confirmed ever smoking regularly (11:4: 'If no, go to question 11:11'), so the entire rest of the smoking sub-section is structurally not applicable -- every dependent field must carry its missing sentinel and every CigaretteConsumption band must carry the missing-numeric sentinel (all three bands are always delivered).
Skip pattern: the participant has not confirmed stopping smoking (11:6), so a stop age is structurally not applicable -- R0_SmokingStopAge must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.

Diet routing: the participant reports eating meat (11:11), so a last-eaten age or never-eaten flag are structurally not applicable -- R0_MeatLastAge/R0_MeatNever must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.
Diet routing: the participant does not eat meat (11:11), so recent-frequency is structurally not applicable -- R0_MeatDaysRecentWeek must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.

Diet routing: the participant reports eating fish (11:12), so a last-eaten age or never-eaten flag are structurally not applicable -- R0_FishLastAge/R0_FishNever must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.
Diet routing: the participant does not eat fish (11:12), so recent-frequency is structurally not applicable -- R0_FishDaysRecentWeek must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.

Diet routing: the participant reports eating eggs (11:13), so a last-eaten age or never-eaten flag are structurally not applicable -- R0_EggLastAge/R0_EggNever must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.
Diet routing: the participant does not eat eggs (11:13), so recent-frequency is structurally not applicable -- R0_EggDaysRecentWeek must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.

Diet routing: the participant reports eating dairy products (11:14), so a last-eaten age or never-eaten flag are structurally not applicable -- R0_DairyLastAge/R0_DairyNever must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.
Diet routing: the participant does not eat dairy products (11:14), so recent-frequency is structurally not applicable -- R0_DairyDaysRecentWeek must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.

Diet routing: the participant reports eating soya products (11:15), so a last-eaten age or never-eaten flag are structurally not applicable -- R0_SoyaLastAge/R0_SoyaNever must carry the missing-numeric sentinel.
